body:
## Summary
- **Shift+click** mixer meter cycles Input → PreFader → PostFader → Output.
- Small In/Pre/Pst/Out badge above the meter; snap `track_meter_point[]`.
- Dummy `--smoke-meter-point` asserts full cycle and leaves PostFader.

## Smoke
```
win_ardour\run-engine-shell-release.bat --backend Dummy --smoke-meter-point --timeout 25 --no-splash
```
exit 0.

## Policy
Modern D2D + thin Cairo; no gtkmm2; WASAPI shared. Independent of #79–#81.
title: Cycle strip meter point Input/Pre/Post/Output
